propositions: The inbound fetcher processes only a single tracker project per run, silently dropping parent/comment/issuelink enrichment data for all but one project in a multi-project store mapping.
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project or associated repos, leaving bridge_project and repos fields unset.

The solution fans out base JQL queries and all three enrichment passes once per configured project, merging results into a shared snapshot deduplicated by jira key, while maintaining per-project query ceiling and fail-open enrichment semantics.
Source project is derived from the jira key prefix (e.g. DIG-123 → DIG) and repos are looked up from the mapping entry, stamped at CREATE write time via a new projects_store helper.
Single-project (unseeded) mappings preserve byte-identical pre-change query and enrichment behavior via a fallback to the original single-project code path.
